title: Style: the forest kitchen, all the way round
note: The original forest splat is kept where its photo saw it well. Every other surface was painted by SDXL on the miniature’s geometry, and nothing stays a flat picture: painted details get depth from Depth Anything V2, and the shelf and the chair are real 3D objects, whole from every side. Its back corner is a new picture of this style (scored automatically for geometry, colour and splat-readiness), made 3D by ViewCrafter and a splat.
